issues.detail: The skill does not explicitly cover error handling or edge cases beyond typical usage.
Examples and guidelines assume a React environment, limiting applicability to other frameworks.

scenarios.name: toggle-switch-with-variants
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers all rubric items except the disabled usage example, while Response B includes the disabled example but fails to use cn for class merging, resulting in a lower score.

scenarios.name: status-badge-with-compound-variants
scenarios.rationale: Response A fully satisfies all rubric requirements, while Response B omits the required cva definition, defaultVariants, cn usage, and compoundVariants, thus failing the rubric.

scenarios.name: combine-variant-functions-with-cx
scenarios.rationale: Response A defines both cva functions, combines them with cx, and includes a full component, though it omits cn; Response B fails to merge icon styles into the button class and also omits cn, making it less complete.
